pr8.title: research(R07,D04): verify logical admission and refine native adapter lifecycle boundaries
pr8.body:
## Research continuation after completed migration

Design PR7 and Plan PR4 migrated the experimental workspace; product PR1 was closed without merge. Product main/history are unchanged. This PR is Design-owned R07/D04 research, not formal A/B Delivery.

## New actual experiment

Primary tested source `28f6cf7e6e4e80b9f32a92ad587a528d82911bd0`, run **43373306474**. Windows/Linux normal and actual Native AOT each passed653 assertions, three groups and64 guided call/Dispose rounds. The original SafeHandle-only facade is a safe-memory negative control: it accepts another call after Dispose while an older call still owns a reference. The private gated facade rejects new calls, allows the old one to finish, keeps FFI outside the gate, and compensates an exception after lease acquisition. The migrated native sources are unchanged.

Pinned .NET SafeHandle source was inspected and byte-verified. Further SeaQuery dynamic statement/rendering, Tower ResponseFuture permit and Rust1.100 Mutex-poisoning source inspection refines the separation of logical admission, physical lifetime, native mutation, retained bytes and async retirement. No C# SQL/network engine or global Core runtime is added. SeaORM remains a real dynamic alternative; no new SeaORM/PG or C# Handler experiment is claimed.

## Detailed design and evidence

The R07 report includes operation signatures, state/linearization table, failure paths, cost model and precise future A03/A20/B11/B17 acceptance inputs. D04 receives a non-normative finite execution addendum; its protocol remains0.1.0-draft/proposed and its exact content hash is updated. No formal contract acceptance or independent review is claimed.

The initial broad CI path pattern accidentally reran identical test inputs on docs-helper commit9fed6f5 in run43374127432. Both actual results are retained and distinguished; the extra run is not counted as new coverage. Triggers now select actual test inputs. The final docs workflow verifies evidence and source bytes without executing the suites again.

Independent D32 review and full async/callback/GC/finalizer/mutable-query/real Server integration, PostgreSQL, performance and production tests remain obligations. Normal expected-head merge only after final checks; no license/protection or product-repository source changes.
